title: Refuse incompatible sheet instance selection
description: Prevent a project from selecting a SheetInstance bound to a different layout identity or revision and return a structured, actionable explanation.
acceptanceCriteria: Selection compares exact project and instance layout identity plus revision
Any mismatch refuses selection with stable machine-readable reasons
Refusal does not remap used positions, mutate the project, or mutate the instance
The explanation identifies how to choose a matching instance or project revision

steps.details: Add a pure serializable SheetInstanceSelectionResult with compatible/refused status, ordered reason codes, and next actions.
Evaluate project and instance layout references without name-based matching, fallback, or position remapping.
Apply the result before persistence and display semantic reason text while leaving both records unchanged on refusal.
Cover exact match, identity mismatch, revision mismatch, missing revision, same-name mismatch, atomic refusal, and keyboard explanation.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; implement one pure selection guard and focused mismatch tests.
Do not migrate used positions between revisions implicitly, even when grids appear similar.
Compatibility here is structural only, not mechanical refeeding safety.
